Purpose and exclusions

Simple authored factions give recorded standing gains/losses, thresholds and service/quest/price unlocks. Reputation changes come from validated events and should not make required progression permanently impossible.

Never bypass the declared rule owner, mutate an authored definition at runtime, trust a client completion claim, or infer a compiled implementation from this page.

Creation and configuration

  1. Author RiverCompact, CairnWardens, AshenSurvey and TideboundLeague faction definitions with original text and bounded tiers.
  2. Create DA_Faction_RiverCompact and one +100 RoadSupplies reward event as a fixture.
  3. Add URPGReputationComponent to PlayerState and WBP_Stats reputation view.
  4. Reopen NPC/dialogue/quest/vendor/trainer definitions for explicit standing requirements and modifier IDs.
  5. Add negative-standing and threshold-crossing fixtures, including reconnect and stale merchant quote.

Required sequence: create native prerequisites -> actual build -> child/data creation -> configure -> assign to listed consumer -> save -> run named fixture. A compiled shell without its consumer assignment is not feature completion.

Functions, commands and event bindings

Project custom contracts are not engine/plugin nodes. A read-only asset participates through its consumer; it does not inherit that consumer’s mutation methods. Backend endpoint pages label transport proposals explicitly.

ValidateFactionService(CharacterId, ServiceId) -> Allowed|StandingRequiredNative current owner; local request versus server validation as the command states. Backend work is asynchronous, cosmetics observe only after accepted state.

Lifecycle and cleanup

  1. Construct with only safe defaults; no service calls or world scans from construction scripts.
  2. Inject current owner/definition/session and subscribe once after readiness. Possession and replicated state may arrive in either order; guard initialization.
  3. Accept only permitted commands under current identity/epoch; keep local UI/cosmetic prediction separate from committed state.
  4. After server/backend result apply only matching request generation and nonstale revision; late reply to old body does not mutate new body.
  5. On death, transfer, disconnect, restart or teardown cancel transient work, clear input/timers, unbind delegates and release weak observers. Durable receipts remain authoritative.
  6. On reconnect create fresh runtime objects from current committed snapshot; never deserialize old Actor/widget pointers or rerun initial grants.

Concrete player-to-authority flow

Participation in Factions, reputation and service unlocks. Rule owner: URPGReputationComponent. This asset’s role is Simple authored factions give recorded standing gains/losses, thresholds and service/quest/price unlocks. Reputation changes come from validated events and should not make required progression permanently impossible.

  1. Quest/world-event/combat policy emits a verified reputation entitlement with faction and bounded delta.
  2. Backend deduplicates, clamps within allowed range, persists event/standing and returns new revision.
  3. Zone updates owner reputation view and re-evaluates relevant NPC/dialogue/trainer/vendor conditions.
  4. Merchant quote includes the current reputation modifier/version; a change invalidates stale quotes under the chosen quote policy.
  5. UI explains standing thresholds and affected unlocks without recomputing authoritative prices.
  6. Content validation ensures the main quest route has recovery/alternate access when optional faction choices reduce standing.

Named fixture and acceptance

Fixture: L_Rillmere / NPC_Mara / ReputationFixture_A. Configure this asset at its first phase and run the linked phase recipe. Actual result: not run in Unreal/backend during documentation generation.

Stimulus / expected result
Replay reputation reward -> unchanged standing.
Client submits arbitrary delta -> InvalidSource.
Threshold table unsorted -> validation fails.
Required story service inaccessible after optional choice -> content gate fails until alternate route exists.

Record expected/observed separately. Reopen the concrete map consumer; inspect authoritative state, stable IDs/revisions and UI. Static link checks cannot satisfy this gameplay test.

Common mistakes and staged limits

Do not duplicate a native rule in Blueprint, assume a planned type is compiled, or keep callbacks/owners valid after world or session replacement.

Do not build later references as empty shells in an earlier phase. Source-derived art rows remain blocked by the missing ZIP; plugin API bindings remain blocked by installed-source verification. Placeholder visuals and proposed tuning are explicitly not production proof.
